activities.description: Presentation of a planet shattering animation. Text on screen highlights the discovery.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: In space, there's a planet entirely made of diamonds?
Scientists have discovered a planet called 55 Cancri A,
located 40 light years away, where the surface is believed to be covered in a thick layer of diamonds.
This incredible celestial gem is eight times the size of earth
and has temperatures soaring over 3,900 degrees Fahrenheit,
making it a scorching hot paradise of precious stones.
So next time you're thinking about splurging on some jewelry,
just imagine owning an entire planet made of diamonds.
